title: Tidy two leftovers of the record-currency follow door: the writeFace description and the per-registration scan cost
body:
domain:server#2 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufziCTpjnYbdh76SAWwb

Origin: nits N3 and N5 of the contract review of PR #32368 (6782495106), card #32312. Serial: after #32368 merges.

- **N3:** `SaveMetaItemRequestSchema.writeFace`'s description (`packages/spec/src/api/protocol.zod.ts`) says the face only selects how two refusals are rendered. Since #32368 the face (with `mode`) also decides whether the save asks the registry-dependent doors. Restate the description. Comment only, no schema change.
- **N5:** the follow door walks every field of every registered object on each opted-in registration, twice on a `/meta` single save (pre-flight, then registration). D6's scan runs only when the body holds a record-mode amount. Bound it the same way: skip the scan when neither the body nor any registered child follows a path into this object. Index the followers if a measurement shows the scan matters.

Premise re-check: after #32368 lands, `git grep -n "writeFace" -- packages/spec/src/api/protocol.zod.ts` shows the description, and `git grep -n "againstRegistry" -- packages/objectql/src` shows the door's call site.

Clause-②: no
